title: Lost in Love
overview: Hope and Jeb are touring the Ephesus ancient ruins but then are left behind by their tour bus. They must help each other get back to Istanbul. Along the way, Hope draws closer to the memory of a dear loved one, while Jeb fears for his career that's waiting back home. Their journey will help put in perspective what they want in life and their feelings for each other.
